tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm ledger paper; the ground everything sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, receipts, tables and form fields on paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on paper, surface and both tints. Fill of the primary button (text in paper).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on paper, surface and both tints.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, table rows and card borders. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: pharmacy
tokens.usage: Pharmacy side: column label, links, icons and solid fills (text in surface). Readable as text on paper, surface and pharmacy-tint.

tokens.name: pharmacy-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the pharmacy column and pharmacy chips. Text on it in ink, muted or pharmacy.

tokens.name: distributor
tokens.usage: Distributor side: column label, links, icons and solid fills (text in surface). Readable as text on paper, surface and distributor-tint.

tokens.name: distributor-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the distributor column and distributor chips. Text on it in ink, muted or distributor.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Overdue, shortage and negative figures only, as text on surface or paper. A state, never decoration.
